headline: Revolut Italia under commissioner: operations worth €76.5 million in the crosshairs
summary: The Milan Court ordered one year of judicial administration for the digital bank, with operations worth €76.5 million in focus. Prosecutors allege serious shortcomings in anti-money laundering controls.
why: Revolut is a UK-founded digital bank and fintech whose regulatory compliance, especially on anti-money laundering, is closely watched by investors and regulators.
